description: Main entry point for a Vue.js frontend application, setting up the Vue app, plugins, and mounting it to the DOM.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Creates a new Vue application instance with the specified root component.

methods.name: createPinia
methods.description: Creates a Pinia store instance for state management.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers a plugin or router with the Vue application.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue application to a DOM element.
